keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Eddy Kouadio (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Idrissa Touré (Monza).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Monza).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half begins Monza 0, Atalanta 0.
Leonardo Colombo (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Monza 0, Atalanta 1. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Monza. Andrea Carboni replaces Eddy Kouadio.
Substitution, Monza. Exequiel Zeballos replaces Jay Robinson.
Substitution, Monza. Dany Mota replaces Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
Substitution, Monza. Adam Bakoune replaces Idrissa Touré.
Substitution, Atalanta. Jonathan Rowe replaces Eljif Elmas.
Substitution, Atalanta. Relja Obric replaces Sead Kolasinac.
Substitution, Monza. Andrea Colpani replaces Mathis Mout because of an injury.
Substitution, Atalanta. Franck Kessie replaces Nikola Krstovic.
Éderson (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card.
Andrea Carboni (Monza) is shown the yellow card.
Andrea Colpani (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Monza 0, Atalanta 1.
